{{Quote|We aren't barons or anything, but we have our family holdings, investments on Ma'ar Shaddam and Rseik proper ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Memoirs of Firmus Kett|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Rseik''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located within the [[Rseik system/Legends|Rseik system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Rseikharhl]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> At some point following [[214 BBY]], the [[Kett family]] maintained investments on Rseik, a fact which was noted in the memoirs of the [[Trade Defense Force]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Firmus Kett]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rseik was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the celestial body was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Rseik was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Rseik [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square N-20.<ref name="TEA" />
